showcase.user_prompt: 帮我做一个能在活动面板展示项目指标的 Vetta 插件。
showcase.assistant_reply: 我会先读取内置插件手册，再创建工程、实现扩展点、构建安装包并应用到当前 Vetta。

items.title: 描述插件目标
items.description: 说明入口、交互与需要使用的宿主能力。

items.title: 由 Vetta 实现
items.description: 根据包内开发手册创建清单、源码、权限和本地化资源。

items.title: 构建并应用
items.description: 在工作台中构建、安装、重载或开启热更新。

blocks.content: 先从输入栏开启“制作插件”模式，插件文档、Skill 和工作台能力才会进入当前会话。

showcase.user_prompt: Build a Vetta plugin that shows project metrics in the activity panel.
showcase.assistant_reply: I’ll read the bundled plugin manual, scaffold the project, implement the extension, package it, and apply it to this Vetta installation.

blocks.title: From idea to a running plugin

items.title: Describe the goal
items.description: Explain the entry point, interaction, and host capabilities you need.

items.title: Let Vetta implement it
items.description: Create the manifest, source, permissions, and locale resources from the bundled manual.

items.title: Build and apply
items.description: Package, install, reload, or start hot reload from the workbench.

blocks.content: Enable Plugin Workbench from the input bar before using its documentation, Skill, and project tools in a conversation.
